descriptions.zh:
先获取推流域名，再调用本接口查询直播边缘转推配置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Get the ingest domain, then call this operation to query the configuration of edge stream relay.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-edge-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
